note: Prove by induction on n. If any x_i=x_j, both sides vanish. Otherwise define p(t) by replacing the final row with (1,t,...,t^{n-1}). Then p(x_i)=0 for i<n and deg p<=n-1, so p(t)=c product_{i<n}(t-x_i). The t^{n-1} coefficient is the positive (n,n)-cofactor, hence c=D_{n-1}. Invoke the induction hypothesis and set t=x_n. No predecessor facts or external results are needed.
